llmnav-catalog/1 repository=llmnav catalog=llmnav.eval
Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@llmnav.eval.measure
role Measure whether repository task queries retrieve expected semantic IDs within configured rank gates.
owns search regression tests, recall metrics, evaluation gates
excludes benchmark task execution, model quality scoring
rel workflow>llmnav.search.query

@llmnav.eval.conformance
role Measure repository-specific navigation evidence and preserve unmeasured language gaps before stability claims.
owns conformance matrix validation, repository verdicts, language evidence coverage
excludes source mutation, cross-repository score averaging
invariant A passing repository cannot hide a failing repository through aggregate metrics. Missing adoption or insufficient reviewed cases remains held rather than passing or failing.
rel workflow>llmnav.eval.measure

@llmnav.eval.real-navigation
role Measure repeatable source navigation tasks on copied real TypeScript and Go code without altering original repositories.
owns real-source corpus provenance, retrieval condition comparison, index maintenance measurements, held model evidence
excludes model coding success claims, human authoring time estimates, original source mutation
invariant Candidate retrieval measurements never stand in for model task completion or unmeasured human maintenance.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze

@llmnav.eval.model-coding
role Grade actual model edits on isolated mutated real source with acceptance tests unavailable in the model workspace.
owns coding outcome oracles, condition rotation, sanitized tool traces, model usage accounting
excludes production source modification, sealed holdout claims, self-reported success grading
invariant Every scored mutation first passes a pristine-positive and mutant-negative oracle control.

@llmnav.eval.serena-navigation
role Compare semantic lookup on copied real source using Serena and the frozen declaration oracles.
owns Serena retrieval measurements, symbol input mapping, external tool provenance
excludes model coding outcomes, timing superiority claims
invariant Tool failures remain failed observations and never become substitute text searches.
